Case B: The manager says no action is needed until the state technician license expires because national certification is a separate credential.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Changing work assignments eliminates any separate certification-loss report.
A lapsed national certificate automatically makes the active state license a revoked license.
The technician must be treated within the ordinary technician duties and title while certification is lapsed.
The previous certified classification remains valid for ratio purposes until the next schedule is posted.

choice_analysis.C: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. certification lapse 시 ordinary technician의 duties·title로 제한된다.

Case B: An intern under direct pharmacist supervision counsels a patient, while a technician offers to resolve a drug-interaction alert independently.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: A successful barcode scan authorizes the technician to perform final dispensing validation.
Delegating the offer necessarily delegates the counseling itself.
A properly supervised intern may counsel, but the technician may not independently resolve the clinical alert.
A certified technician's medication-history authority includes prescribing a replacement therapy.

explanation.core_reasoning: 기술적 일치 확인은 pharmacist의 최종 법적·임상적 검수를 대신하지 않는다. intern의 감독하 상담과 technician의 clinical judgment 금지를 구분한다. offer와 actual counseling은 서로 다른 행위다. 정보수집의 허용을 평가·치료변경으로 확대하지 않는다.

선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 기술적 일치 확인은 pharmacist의 최종 법적·임상적 검수를 대신하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: Final patient-specific dispensing validation remains the pharmacist's responsibility.
choice_analysis.B:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. offer와 actual counseling은 서로 다른 행위다.
교정된 설명: An offer of counseling may be conveyed by a trained designee without delegating actual counseling.
choice_analysis.C: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. intern의 감독하 상담과 technician의 clinical judgment 금지를 구분한다.
choice_analysis.D:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 정보수집의 허용을 평가·치료변경으로 확대하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: Medication-history collection does not itself authorize assessment and therapy changes.

Delegating permitted handling transfers the pharmacist's security responsibility to the technician.
All Schedule II formulations necessarily have identical technician-handling permissions.
Every licensed technician has the same Schedule II handling authority regardless of certification.

Case A: Two licensed nationally certified technicians perform a Schedule II perpetual-inventory count under the specified pharmacist verification arrangement.

Case B: One technician finds a discrepancy and edits the balance without involving the MOR or the designated pharmacist.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Matching the electronic total to the count completes the required discrepancy investigation.
Authority to enter routine transactions includes independent authority to erase unexplained discrepancies.
Only an unlicensed inventory vendor may make routine electronic inventory entries.
The permitted paired-technician count still requires the supervising pharmacist's verification.

explanation.core_reasoning: 허용된 두 CPhT count 경로에도 pharmacist verification이 남는다. routine entry와 discrepancy adjustment 권한을 분리한다. CPhT의 허용 entry와 unlicensed 인력의 금지를 구분한다. 숫자를 맞추는 조작만으로 원인 조사·보고 판단이 완료되지 않는다.

교정된 설명: An unexplained difference requires investigation rather than a silent numerical correction.

교정된 설명: A discrepancy adjustment follows the MOR or authorized pharmacist-designee pathway.

선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. CPhT의 허용 entry와 unlicensed 인력의 금지를 구분한다.
교정된 설명: A certified technician may make permitted perpetual-inventory entries.
choice_analysis.D: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 허용된 두 CPhT count 경로에도 pharmacist verification이 남는다.
